function.name: UploadFile
function.description: Upload a local file to a specified folder in Dropbox cloud storage.

local_file_path.description: Path to the local file to be uploaded.

cloud_folder_path.description: Destination folder path in Dropbox cloud storage.

function.name: DownloadFile
function.description: Download a file from Dropbox cloud storage to a local folder.

user_cloud_file_path.description: Path to the file in the user's Dropbox cloud storage.

shared_file_id.description: ID of a shared file to download.

local_destination_folder.description: Local folder path where the file will be saved.

function.name: ListFilesAndFolders
function.description: List files and folders in a specified Dropbox cloud folder.

cloud_folder_path.description: Path to the folder in Dropbox cloud storage.

max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return in the list.

function.name: CreateFolder
function.description: Create a new folder in the specified parent folder in Dropbox.

folder_name.description: Name of the new folder to create.

parent_folder_path.description: Path to the parent folder where the new folder will be created.

function.name: ShareItem
function.description: Share a Dropbox item with a specified recipient at a given access level.

item_path.description: Path to the item to be shared in Dropbox.

recipient_email.description: Email address of the recipient to share with.

access_level.description: Access level granted to the recipient, must be view, comment, or edit.

function.name: DeleteDropboxItem
function.description: Delete an item or folder from Dropbox cloud storage.

item_path.description: Path to the item or folder to be deleted.

function.name: SearchDropboxItems
function.description: Search for items in Dropbox by name or path.

query.description: Search query string to match against item names and paths.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

function.name: GetItemMetadata
function.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific item in Dropbox.

item_path.description: Path to the item whose metadata is to be retrieved.
